body_markdown:
Everyone has their own way of using Spotify. And sometimes, that means wanting more say in what stays, what goes, and what’s easy to find. We’ve heard from listeners looking for more control, so we’re introducing new ways to manage your Spotify Home feed.


-


- **Remove a tile from the top of your Homepage:** Hide recently listened to content from the top of your Home feed. Press and hold any music, podcast, or audiobook you no longer want to see, then select “Remove from this section.”


- **Remove from Recents:** Hide individual items from your Recents shelf. Press and hold an item, then select “Remove from this section.”


- **Use “Not interested” across Home:** We’ve expanded the ability to use “Not interested” on your Home feed: you can now choose to hear less from specific shows or authors.


These updates build on tools like


[Taste Profile](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2026-09-23/taste-profile-shape-home-feed/) (in beta in the U.S. and New Zealand), which lets eligible Premium listeners tell Spotify what they’d like to hear more or less of, helping shape their Home feed recommendations.


These controls do two different jobs. Removing something from a section is a quick way to clean up your Home feed and does not affect future recommendations. Using “Not interested” and “Taste Profile” helps Spotify shape what gets recommended going forward.


NEXT


The new controls are rolling out globally to Free and Premium listeners on mobile. Make sure your app is


[up to date](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-11-28/spotify-app-update-wrapped-features/) so you always have access to the latest features.
